{{Top|leg}}
The '''Commercial District''' was the business region of [[Estalle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. The service industries that kept the island running were located in the Commercial District, along with [[Bank/Legends|banks]], [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], and [[Cantina/Legends|bars]]. Major businesses maintained offices in the district, and large transportation hubs were situated within its boundary.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

Locations within the Commercial District included the [[Tapani Royal Spaceport]], [[Givoni Airport]], [[Estalle Seaport]], [[Corellian Merchants' Guild Guildhouse (Procopia)|Corellian Merchants' Guild Guildhouse]], [[Mining Guild Sector Headquarters]], the [[Tapani Exchange]], [[Shinda Center]], [[Falley Club]], [[Fairweld Casino]], [[Drake Theatre]], [[Chandler's Royale]], [[Grand Royal Hotel]], and the [[Tapani Imperial Hotel]].<ref name="LE" />
